title: JAB Visions Board
summary: Board is JAB Visions' evolving creator-production network and creative operating system for sharing work, building profiles, organizing projects, and connecting creative activity.
facts: Board began as a private production tool for JAB Visions cast and crew and is evolving into a broader creator-production network.
A Drop is Board's core unit of creative material. Current implementations support text, image, video, audio, document, link, and payment-request contexts.
Board's public areas include Feed, Forums, Work, Profile, Explore, Friend Zone, Drop Studio, and Drop Pad OS experiences.
Pass, Pin, and Push are interaction signals attached to Drops.
Board is currently a web beta. Features and language should be described as evolving rather than finished or guaranteed.
